commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single original VEILBOUND sealed monster playing card face. Portrait 5:7, flat straight-on, fills image to edge. Original high fantasy design. Lacquer-black outer frame, thin inlaid brass lines, bold angular parchment rank tab in top left and clean suit symbol in top right, small matching brass clasp at lower center. In the image panel a large segmented luminous arcane binding ring wraps BEHIND the silhouette, three little metal locks on the outside of the circle convey a creature trapped inside an artifact. Strong creature silhouette dominates 80% of art panel, full body, brighter than its subdued blue-charcoal environment. Stylized high-contrast 2D gouache and angular creature anatomy with a little ink texture; large readable shapes, restrained background, no photorealism, no crowded filigree. Make the creature fierce. Header should be simple and legible. No other words, no mockup, no barcode, no existing character likeness.
